 For R3 : Ms.S.Devasena

 Special Government Plead
 Order

This writ petition has been filed for the issue of writ of mandamus to forbear the respondents from evicting the petitioner from the subject property without following the due process of law and without paying the compensation to the petitioner.
2.The present writ petition has been filed by the petitioner on a mere apprehension without any materials.
The petitioner has given a representation on 29.09.2021 and has filed this writ petition on 07.10.2021.

This Court will https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis not exercise its writ jurisdiction in a case of this nature, more particularly, where the petition is filed on a mere apprehension without any solid facts.

3.When the matter is taken up for hearing today, it is submitted by the learned Special Government Pleader and the learned Standing Counsel for the respondents that the petitioner had approached this Court without any basis and only on apprehension.
4.In view of the above, this Court does not see any ground to pass orders in this writ petition.
Accordingly, this Writ Petition is dismissed.
No costs.
Consequently, connected miscellaneous petition is also closed.
